| description = After the turnin to [[Chrislin Baker]], a Human monk named Thrackin Griften will then spawn at Loc 800, -11570.

Kill him and loot the White Paper. Take a group with some tanks and a cleric. 

1/13/26: I don't think he's that high of MR. 60 Ranger snared on first try no tash. 55 Enchanter slowed after 4 tries after tash. Pretty easy fight for 60 ranger, 60 monk, and 55 enchanter (all raid geared).

3/3/26: Killed him with a war (60) and a torpor epic shaman (60). Malo, slow got on it easily. War used disc, Torpor heals were enough.

04/13/2026: After tash, slow and cripple landed first try. Asphyxiate first try. Got a bunch of resists on torment of argli and dementia. Possibly higher resists than a normal 55 but nothing crazy.

5/30/2026 Seems that he is unfearable.  20+ casts of invoke fear and trepidation and none landed.

6/15/2026: Soloable on a 60 shaman.  Malosini and tash stick pretty much required, very resistant.  Epic dot and pet can barely out pace his regen.  Pox/Bane about a 50% land rate.  Slow landed pretty comfortably after malosini/tash stick.

8/10/2026: Soloable on a 60 enchanter using Vilnius the Small as a pet hasted with VoG. Rapture/tash/slow/cripple on Thrackin then spam rune/bedlam on Vilnius until Thrackin runs. Vilnius also likes to backstab for high 300s when you step in melee range of Thrackin. Note: the tower guards will also aggro and fight Thrackin if he gets close to them (they can also be pre-hasted).
